grok.pulse: NQ ~-1.5% to -1.9% premarket at a fresh overnight low as the AI unwind goes global (Nikkei/Kospi ~-5%, Taiwan -6.6%) with ANT -10% day 2 and INTU -10% on a guide cut; only offset is yields easing to ~4.99% and a stretched six-day S&P slide.
grok.bias: risk-off — AI/semis liquidation (ANT, AMD, MU, TSM lower), VIX >30, hawkish Fed pricing (gold -8% wk on hike bets) and fresh Iran strike headlines; Waller 8:25 AM is the next swing factor
items: @FirstSquawk (~7:25 AM ET): $ANT extends premarket decline to more than 10%, day 2 after its IPO — Bearish NQ
@T_LauRekt (~7:29 AM ET): NQ futs ~-1.5%, ES ~-0.6% after Taiwan -6.6%, Kospi -5.2%, Nikkei -5.1% overnight — Bearish NQ
@DeItaone (~7:03 AM ET): VIX rises above 30; AI selloff accelerating ($AMD ~-6%, $INTC lower premarket) — Bearish NQ
@DeItaone (~7:11 AM ET): CBS: US and Israel considering a new near-term military assault on Iran; Iran tankers massing at Kharg to test US blockade — Bearish NQ
@DeItaone (~6:49 AM ET): Gold -8% this week as markets price another Fed hike; SocGen sees two more 25bp hikes — Bearish NQ
grok.trump: At APEC (Nov 19, ~8:30 PM ET story) Trump told Xi the US does not support Taiwan independence and they agreed an action plan for 'constructive strategic stability' (mild de-escalation, China/chips positive); he also urged European allies to halt Ukraine aid. No new tariff or Fed comments overnight.
grok.watch: Waller 8:25 AM ET (hike signals), UMich final sentiment/inflation expectations 10:00 AM ET, monthly OPEX into the close, ANT/INTU/semis at the 9:30 AM open, Iran strike and Kharg/Hormuz tanker headlines for CL; next week DELL, HPQ, WDAY, ADSK Tue Nov 24 AMC

items: @DTradingToolkit (~7:00 AM ET): Asia got smoked overnight — Nikkei and Kospi both fell about 5%, Nasdaq futures about 1.5%; green premarket in red tape is a gift to sellers

@QuasarMarkets (~5:53 AM ET): The AI rout is the whole tape — S&P closed -2.02% for sixth straight loss, Asia followed hard (Kospi -5.1%, Nikkei -4.7%); NQ futures -1.55%, ES -0.61%
@TradePhantomX (~5:48 AM ET): AI sell-off spread to Asia; SoftBank -14%, ANT ~-6% pre-market still above IPO; NQ down ~1% while YM/RTY holding, gold liquidating
@sports_lamb (~6:57 AM ET): Rough Friday for AI — Nasdaq futures -1.6% as selloff goes global; $ANT -6% day after debut, $AMD -5% on China short-seller report, $NVDA -2.6%
